name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-10-24, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.92 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
